now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 30, in 1945, Dugan and Morita join Peggy Carter's SSR raid on HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrest its leader.

proposed.text: In episode 23, in 1945, Dugan and Morita join Peggy Carter's SSR raid on HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrest its leader.

changes.evidence: The 1945 SSR raid with Peggy, Dugan and Morita that captures Werner Reinhardt is the cold open of 'Shadows', season 2 episode 1, which is episode 23 of the whole show (season 1 has 22). Not episode 30. The Jim Morita file already tags it episode 23.

now.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
now.text: Jon Jon films Shaun's bus fight, and the video makes him famous online.

proposed.text: Jon Jon, Xialing's right-hand man, announces the fights at her underground fight club in Macau.

changes.evidence: Jon Jon is Xialing's right-hand man and the announcer at her underground fight club in Macau. He does not film the bus fight: that is Klev, a bus rider who livestreams it. The file's 'kind' ("Shaun and Katy's friend") is wrong too and should read something like "Xialing's right-hand man at her fight club".

proposed.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
proposed.text: In episode 5, after Karli kills Lemar in Riga, Walker takes the serum and kills a Flag Smasher with the shield in front of a crowd. Sam and Bucky take the shield from him, and he is stripped of the title of Captain America.
cases: ST-083 The Riga Incident (The Falcon and the Winter Soldier)

changes.evidence: Insert as the first record, before k0 ('after': null = goes first). Episode 4: Walker takes the last serum vial and, after Lemar's death, kills a Flag Smasher with the shield on camera. Episode 5: Sam and Bucky take the shield, and Walker gets an other than honorable discharge and loses the Captain America title. This is the file's main fall and has no record. ST-083 is the case the Lemar Hoskins file uses for the same fight.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
now.text: In episode 3, Convicted as the Swordsman, Jack is freed from Red Hook by Daredevil and drives the other prisoners to safety.

proposed.text: In episode 12, Convicted as the Swordsman, Jack is freed from Red Hook by Daredevil and drives the other prisoners to safety.

changes.evidence: Jack's trial, conviction and the Red Hook breakout are in Born Again's 12th episode overall (season 2 episode 3; season 1 has 9 episodes). The brief says 'In episode N' counts episodes across the whole show, so 'episode 3' would point to a season 1 episode. If the app numbers Born Again S2 by season, the current text is already right.

now.title: Secret Invasion
now.text: A Skrull named Raava has been posing as Rhodey. The real Rhodey is freed from a Skrull prison when Gravik falls.

changes.evidence: In the finale, G'iah frees Gravik's human prisoners, Rhodes and Ross among them, at New Skrullos (Gravik's base in Russia), after Gravik is killed there. 'Washington, D.C.' fits only Raava's impersonation. Use the app's own name for the New Skrullos place if it has one.
